sentences.japanese: また後でかけ直していただけませんか？
sentences.english: Could you call again later, please?

sentences.japanese: 傷を付けたのは私だけど、こんなの簡単に直せる傷よ。
sentences.english: I was the one who scratched it, but this kind of scratch is easy to fix.

sentences.japanese: 君は直に出発する方がいい。
sentences.english: You may as well leave at once.

sentences.japanese: 君は直ちに家へ帰らなければならない。
sentences.english: You must go home at once.

sentences.japanese: 君は直ちに医者に行く必要がある。
sentences.english: It is necessary for you to see a doctor at once.
